svg.title: PostgreSQL connectivity for custom applications
svg.desc: Two alternative network modes for the same optional PostgreSQL resource. Basic uses a VNet-integrated Container App and dedicated NAT with static public IPv4 to reach a firewall-restricted public PostgreSQL endpoint. Isolation uses a Private Endpoint in the application private-endpoint subnet and private DNS; public PostgreSQL access is disabled. PostgreSQL is an Azure managed service outside the VNet in both views. Both modes use Entra-only authentication and verified TLS. No bundled runtime integration is implied.
svg.text: Same optional resource; two network modes.
PostgreSQL firewall allows the NAT IP plus explicit operator ranges.
Public PostgreSQL access is disabled. No Basic NAT is added in this mode.
Both modes: Entra-only authentication and verified TLS.
